negative_control: At radius 1/2 this count statistic is ambiguous: each field admits counts zero and one, with explicit uniform-displacement witnesses. This does not prove ambiguity of full spectra.

scope: The complete classification concerns only fields with the stated metadata. General ramification and discriminant arguments are source-backed written mathematics.
